core.title: 12 Inch Offset Door Pull, First Impressions CF-OFF/12-SSPolychem

text.description_html:
First Impressions CF-OFF/12-SSPolychem 12 Inch Offset Door Pull

This stunning new design 12" door pull features on site adjustable offset brackets with beautiful long lasting stainless steel handles. Assembled in the USA by the expert craftsmen at First Impressions International, famous for high quality innovational door pull designs.

Also available: Offset Teak Door Pull

Note: The Center to Center mounting distance is totally adjustable. Set your desired mounting distance right at the job site. Just slid the offset brackets onto the pull handle and tighten the rear set screws.

Specifications for First Impressions CF-OFF/12-SSPolychem Offset Door Pull

  • Total Length 12"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Bracket Offset: 2-1/2"
  • Total Projection: 3-3/8"
  • Clearance: 1-7/8"
  • Pull Handle Material: Stainless Steel Tube, Satin Stainless Finish
  • Pull Bracket Material: Aluminum, Satin Silver Powder Coat Finish

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door).

*Sold individually (1 door pull handle).
